entries.land_description: On California's northern coast, Mendocino Tubbs offers private natural redwood hot tubs and saunas in a beautiful environment of peace and tranquility. Imagine yourself submerged in soothing hot waters, the clean sky above you, and cool ocean breezes wafting over your body.
entries.notes: Sunday afternoons we offer a women's community hot tub 1-4 pm. A charming cottage with kitchen and bath for two and fine professional massage also available. We are/have: 5 lesbians, 3 nonlesbians, 3 acres.

entries.land_description: We are located three miles from the beautiful north coast of CA, close to state parks, hiking/biking and large women's community, 3 1/2 hours north of San Francisco. We offer a safe and comfortable place for women to stay, either in a large cabin (sleeps four comfortably) with private yard, deck, woodburning stove, loft bedroom-sitting area, kitchen, bath and dining area, or in a smaller unit (marvelous bathroom) with breakfast served in our kitchen overlooking the gardens.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl children, boy children under 10, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: dogs negotiable. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 2 nonlesbians, 2 acres, woods, women living on the land.

entries.land_description: The Butterfly Inn is a bed and breakfast for women. We are located on the Big Island of Hawaii near Hilo and Volcano Nat'l Park - home of the fire goddess Pele. Our home is on an acre of tropical foliage, fruit trees and flowers. We have a quiet, comfortable, healing environment with hot tub, steam house, crystal energy and licensed massage therapist available.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl children 12 and over, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: TV, sound system, telephone and tour information. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 1 acre, sugar cane fields in a rural area, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: I have a cozy old plantation style home on 14 acres of rural land in a remote, quiet area of the Big Island of Hawaii. The airports are Kona, or Hilo (which is closer). Provide your own transportation and plan to arrive in daylight hours. Close to Punalu'u Black Sand Beach, and Volcano National Park, home of Madame Pele, Hawaii's very active Fire Goddess.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, occasionally a male if accompanied by a woman
entries.notes: Unique outside steambath, licensed Lomi Lomi massage therapist. No smoking inside. Sliding scale, work exchange considered. We are/have: 14 acres, accessible, woods, farmland, camping space.

entries.land_description: Valley Creek Cottage is a country B & B located in southwestern Oregon only 4 miles off Interstate 5. The cottage is a free-standing building to guarantee privacy. It has a bedroom, living room with TV/VCR, private bath with a door to the private outdoor hot tub, large sundeck overlooking a mountain creek and a cozy woodstove. A gourmet continental breakfast is delivered each morning to the cottage. Open year round.
entries.notes: We have: woods, women living on the land.

entries.land_description: Mountain River Inn Bed and Breakfast offers a drug and alcohol free environment for women. It is a very beautiful and secluded spot with private river access - a great place to relax, write, compose, draw, paint.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl children, boy children by prior arrangement, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: Breakfast includes farm fresh eggs or can be dairy free. Organic garden. Sauna, hot tub. No smoking indoors. Rooms are $20-50 sliding scale. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 27 acres, woods, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: CarDan Farm B & B is a 32-acre country retreat for women in the heart of southern Oregon, nine miles from Interstate Hwy 5. The farm offers relaxed modern country living at its best. Comfortable accommodations with hot tub, pool, wooded trails, farm animals.
entries.notes: The farm is open to guests May-October. Rates are $45-55/night. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 32 acres, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.

entries.street_address: PO Box 147, 41st Place and Ocean Front
entries.land_description: A bed and breakfast with five ocean view guest rooms on three acres of beachfront land. Stay includes full breakfast, champagne or juice.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl/boy children (by prior arrangement), nonlesbian women
entries.notes: Amenities include outdoor spa, games and fitness room, room with regulation pool table, big screen TV and movies, marble fireplace, Baldwin concert grand piano, library and music room. The house is furnished in European antiques. An elegant relaxed atmosphere to just be ourselves! Rates range from $46-$66 per night. Two night minimum on weekends.

entries.land_description: The Crystal Moon is a small, private lodge with bed and full vegetarian breakfast accommodations, located on 23 forested acres in the Cascade Mountains. The Crystal Moon harmonizes with the natural environment which is abundant with wildflowers, deer, elk, coyotes and birds of many species.
entries.notes: Hiking, cross-country skiing, gem collecting, river rafting, horseback riding and swimming are all nearby. We also have a masseuse in residence. Smoking permitted in designated outside areas only. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 23 acres, woods.
